formlogicPlugin.name: Age gate
formlogicPlugin.description: Lets an app ask its members to confirm their age before it opens: by their own word, or, where the app asks for more, by a face check with the camera that an AI on the administrator's computer reads. Each person does it once on this site.

settings.label: Years above the app's age a face check's estimate must reach
settings.help: An AI's estimate of age is least sure near the line. Someone whose youngest likely age is not this far above the app's age is asked for a stronger check instead.

settings.label: Head turns a face check asks for
settings.help: Where OAIY has its age model, the turns are measured from the face itself. Without it, an AI judges them, and some AI models tell up from down better than left from right.

settings.label: How far each head turn must go, in degrees
settings.help: Measured from the face where OAIY has its age model; up and down need three quarters of it. Lower is easier, and easier to fool. Try it on yourself: the result says how far your turns measured.

settings.label: OAIY's age model
settings.help: OAIY can read ages with an age model of its own (its Age check: MiVOLO v2), with the AI's estimate as the backup. Where it has none, the AI's estimate is used, unless you require the age model.

options.label: Use it where OAIY has it
Require it: no face check without it

passes.label: Age
passes.require: Only for people over an age

strengthLabels.estimated: A face check with the camera
strengthLabels.verified: An ID or digital ID check
